payload.domain: static deflection of slender elastic cantilever beams

chosen_hypothesis.statement: The reference steel cantilever's tip deflection under a 1000 N tip load matches the Euler-Bernoulli prediction within 2% at element degree 2.
chosen_hypothesis.rationale: HAND-FED (not stage-1 output): a known-servable fixed-summary claim to capture the fenicsx stage-2 model-visible surface at its birth (Packet B Phase 2 flip).

qoi.name: tip displacement
qoi.definition: the maximum |u_z| over the displacement dofs — the tip deflection of the transversely loaded cantilever
qoi.how_extracted: returned by the wrapper on every valid run; the requested number per the contract's quantity key
